title: KeywordSuggestionOutput
description: Output schema for the intent keyword suggestion engine (US-213)

current_keyword_count.description: Total number of keywords currently registered for this intent across all languages

suggested_keywords.description: Top 2-3 keyword suggestions derived from TF-IDF analysis of escalated messages

estimated_accuracy_boost_percent.description: Estimated percentage of previously-escalated messages that would be correctly matched if the suggested keywords were added
